title: The Blind Assassin

vibeProfile.oneLine: An old woman unspools her family's secrets, and the novel hidden inside them.

summary: An elderly Iris Chase looks back on her Ontario family's decline and her sister Laura's mysterious death, while a novel-within-the-novel, a pulpy science-fiction romance secretly written by one of them, threads through her account. Atwood nests stories inside stories to build a rich, slow-burning saga of sisters, secrets and a century of Canadian life, withholding its central revelation almost to the end. Intricate and rewarding, it won the Booker Prize and is among her most admired novels.
whyReadIt: Atwood's Booker-winning puzzle box, a family saga with a novel hidden inside it. Slow, intricate and deeply rewarding.

funFacts.text: It won the Booker Prize in 2000.
